market.question: Will Crude Oil (CL) hit (HIGH) $130 by end of June?

assessment.reasoning: WTI ~$96-100. To hit $130 = ~30% rally needed. Achievable if Hormuz closure persists or escalates, which is the current scenario. Citi $150 Brent target implies $135+ WTI possibility. EIA's $115 Brent peak corresponds to ~$110 WTI. $130 is meaningful but realistic only in a prolonged-disruption tail.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Duration of the Hormuz closure and military escalation
